headline: Draft bodywork business rules were discussed, along with a request for more repair time at 2C Street.
summary: Draft rules set what bodywork businesses, such as massage and reflexology, can and cannot do. A public hearing on the draft may come in December. The property owner at 2C Street asked for more time to fix cited violations, and a tenant spoke about conditions in the unit.
discussion: Bodywork draft rules: Members asked about background checks, how fines are appealed, and whether other communities have similar rules.
2C Street repairs: Discussion covered smoke detectors, the roof, and plumbing, and whether to give the owner extra days to finish them. The owner said he is selling the property.
Social consumption: Speakers raised questions about who would enforce the rules, how amounts would be limited, and how state law applies.
City council communication: Members said the council has not asked the board for input and discussed inviting the council president to a future meeting.
